column.headline: Shantanu storms in as Sukrut keeps the top spot
column.text: Shantanu hauled 65 points to win the week and climb from 22nd to 20th, while Sukrut still sits top on 742 with a 24-point cushion over Aditya Dalal. Aryamann's 52 lifted him up to 4th, and Aary's 8-point hit for Groß, De Cuyper and N.Jackson will be the first thing he has to justify. Haaland was the house captain for almost everyone, so the lone-wolf picks decided the drama.

plots.title: The Streak Wobbles
plots.text: Aditya Dalal has been above the league average for 10 weeks in a row, with 112 points in GW2 and 37 in GW11. His GW11 score is the lowest of the whole run, so the streak is now under real pressure.
plots.next: If the points stay low, the run could end and the streak could be settled.
plots.question: How long can Aditya Dalal stay hot?

plots.title: Bench Blunders Pile Up
plots.text: Atharva Kshirsagar has left 216 points on the bench this season, while the league average is 89. The bench keeps costing him, and the season-long question of picking the right 11 is still open.
plots.next: If the bench keeps costing points, the curse could become the league's talking point.
plots.question: Will Atharva Kshirsagar ever pick the right 11?

plots.title: Aryamann Keeps Climbing
plots.text: Aryamann started GW2 in 20th place and now sits 4th out of 24, climbing 16 places since. The rise has been steady, with 8th in GW8, 7th in GW10 and 4th in GW11.
plots.next: If the climb continues, a place in the top 3 could be within reach.
plots.question: How high can Aryamann go?

plots.title: The Gap Shrinks to One
plots.text: Aditya Dharap has cut Atharva Kshirsagar's lead from 44 in GW8 to just 1 in GW11. Atharva is still ahead, but the gap has been shrinking every week.
plots.next: If Aditya Dharap gets past Atharva, the chase could flip in a single gameweek.
plots.question: Can Aditya Dharap catch Atharva Kshirsagar?

plots.title: Sukrut Pulls Clear
plots.text: Sukrut leads on 742 points, 24 ahead of Aditya Dalal on 718, and that gap has grown from 18. Sukrut has now been top for 3 weeks in a row, and the lead has changed hands 5 times this season.
plots.next: If Aditya Dalal, who led in GW7 and GW8, can win points back, the crown could be contested again.
plots.question: Who can hold the crown?

piece.headline: HAALAND BLANKS, Sukrut Stretches the Lead

storylines.title: The Aary hit
storylines.text: Aary took an 8-point hit for Groß, De Cuyper and N.Jackson, and that cost him dearly.

storylines.title: Shantanu's surge
storylines.text: Shantanu's 65-point week was the best of GW11, lifting him from 22nd to 20th.

hot:6543415.title: The Streak Wobbles
hot:6543415.text: Aditya Dalal has been above the league average for 10 weeks in a row, with 112 points in GW2 and 37 in GW11. His GW11 score is the lowest of the whole run, so the streak is now under real pressure.
hot:6543415.next: If the points stay low, the run could end and the streak could be settled.

bench:2784861.title: Bench Blunders Pile Up
bench:2784861.text: Atharva Kshirsagar has left 216 points on the bench this season, while the league average is 89. The bench keeps costing him, and the season-long question of picking the right 11 is still open.
bench:2784861.next: If the bench keeps costing points, the curse could become the league's talking point.

underdog:3504829.title: Aryamann Keeps Climbing
underdog:3504829.text: Aryamann started GW2 in 20th place and now sits 4th out of 24, climbing 16 places since. The rise has been steady, with 8th in GW8, 7th in GW10 and 4th in GW11.
underdog:3504829.next: If the climb continues, a place in the top 3 could be within reach.

chase:3234443.title: The Gap Shrinks to One
chase:3234443.text: Aditya Dharap has cut Atharva Kshirsagar's lead from 44 in GW8 to just 1 in GW11. Atharva is still ahead, but the gap has been shrinking every week.
chase:3234443.next: If Aditya Dharap gets past Atharva, the chase could flip in a single gameweek.

title.title: Sukrut Pulls Clear
title.text: Sukrut leads on 742 points, 24 ahead of Aditya Dalal on 718, and that gap has grown from 18. Sukrut has now been top for 3 weeks in a row, and the lead has changed hands 5 times this season.
title.next: If Aditya Dalal, who led in GW7 and GW8, can win points back, the crown could be contested again.
